svg.title: Declutter versus upgrading a Canadian lease by one bedroom
svg.desc: Keeping a one-bedroom at TRREB Q2 2026 $2,273 plus $180 of vertical storage beats stepping to a StatCan Toronto two-bedroom ask of $2,650. The $377 monthly gap is $4,524 a year - enough to fund shelves, a dresser sale, and a storage exit.
svg.text: Declutter the lease upgrade you do not need
TRREB Q2 2026 1-bed $2,273 vs StatCan QRS Q2 2026 Toronto asking 2-bed $2,650. Vertical storage sketch $180 one-time.
$2,650 - $2,273 = $377/month. Twelve months is $4,524 before last-month rent, movers ($450-$900 studio/1-bed band), and a new hydro account.
If the extra room is for boxes, sell or donate first. Kids- and hobby gear get a labelled cubic-metre budget, not a second bedroom by default.
Mixing TRREB condo 1-beds with StatCan all-apartment 2-beds is labelled on purpose. Use your two quotes. Housing math, not a lifestyle lecture.
